# Pretense

> Real code protection for AI coding tools. Pretense sits between source code and
> the AI tools that read it, so secrets and personal data are swapped for
> stand-ins before any request reaches a third-party model.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/quickstart): Install Pretense and route your first AI tool through it, in 4 commands.
- [AI coding tools](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/ai-tools): Send Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Codex through Pretense in 4 commands. Secrets and PII leave as stand-in tokens. Your code comes back as you wrote it.
- [How it works](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/how-it-works): Why Pretense mutates secrets rather than redacting them. Code names are restored byte-exactly in the reply. Secrets and PII stay as tokens.
- [Configuration](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/config): 1 file and a handful of environment variables. Everything has a working default.
- [CLI reference](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/cli): Every command the shipped binary accepts and what it returns.
- [Air-gap](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/air-gap): Run entirely on your own hardware, with local runners and a licence gate that fails closed.
- [Automation & CI](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/automation): Catch secrets before they are committed and again before they are merged.
- [API & clients](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/api): Point any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible client at Pretense by changing 1 base URL.
- [Code graph](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/code-graph): A local graph of the functions, classes and constants in your repo. It records each identifier on your machine. The renaming happens in the proxy.

## Product

- [Pricing](https://www.pretense.ai/pricing): Plans and what each tier includes.
- [About](https://www.pretense.ai/about): About the company behind Pretense.

- [FAQ](https://www.pretense.ai/faq): Common questions about the product.
- [Security](https://www.pretense.ai/security): How Pretense protects code and data sent to AI models.
- [Enterprise](https://www.pretense.ai/enterprise): Deployment options for larger teams.

## Key facts

- Pretense swaps secrets and PII out of prompts before they reach an AI model. They are never put back into the model's reply, so a model cannot echo them into a link or output.
- Code identifiers are renamed on the way out and restored byte-exactly in the reply.
- The CLI wraps Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and Aider: pretense run <tool>.
- Pretense is not SOC 2 or HIPAA certified today.
- Plans: Free, Startup and Enterprise. Current prices are on the pricing page.

## Install

Install the CLI with:

    curl -fsSL https://www.pretense.ai/install.sh | sh
